mapping.summary: Designs custom BC APIs in-product and generates AL extension source, plus governed data gateways.
claims: Choose tables and fields to expose, with custom API names, captions and read-only settings
Detects parent-child relationships so APIs nest related records
Generates API pages or a flat API query as a downloadable extension bundle
Can output an AL-Go for GitHub repository
Imports an existing API page AL file as an editable solution
Schema discovery and paged read gateway with batching and aggregates
Write gateway is off by default and limited to tables an admin opens, with audit
Ledger entries, posted documents and system logs can never be written via the gateway
Optional approval before generating a bundle, with self-approval blocked
Generates source only; compiling and publishing are done in your own pipeline
BC online version 28.0 or later, English (US) UI
